caption: The drawing depicts a single parasol with a plaid-patterned canopy in shades of beige, light brown, red, and pale green. The canopy is partly edged with a ruffled trim in a muted purple or lavender color. The parasol is open and angled, with its wooden handle and shaft visible, featuring turned details and a light tan color. The tip of the parasol’s handle is darker, possibly indicating a metal or different wooden cap. The parasol is set against a plain, off-white or light beige background with no other objects or decorative elements visible. There are inscriptions on the right side of the image: the name "J.J. O’Neil" printed beside the parasol’s handle, along with partially visible handwritten text at the bottom right edge.
title: Parasol
